title: Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship Programme 2027
overview: Training, mentorship and USD 5,000 of non-returnable seed capital for African entrepreneurs in all 54 countries. The application portal opens every year from 1 January to 1 March.
program_dates: Yearly cycle starting with applications from 1 January
deadline_text: Every year, the application portal opens on the 1st of January till midnight on the 1st of March, on www.TEFConnect.com.
funding_details: Official page: selected participants get access to TEF training, pairing with mentors and coaching; those who complete the investment-readiness phase and pass the document review are 'deemed eligible to receive their $5,000 non-refundable seed capital', paid into the business account
The seed capital is a contribution to launch or scale the business, not a stipend; the page does not use the words 'fully funded'
No application fee is mentioned on the page read
participation_fee: None mentioned on the page read
stipend: None; USD 5,000 non-refundable seed capital for the business after the training and document review
eligibility: Africans aged 18 and above who reside in Africa and plan to establish their business in Africa
A business idea or a business no older than 5 years
Must not have previously benefited from any of the Foundation's earlier programmes
A minimum score in the application's business assessment test
application_process: Register on TEFConnect and complete the application form between 1 January and 1 March
Eligibility notification after the business assessment test
Due diligence, shortlisting, training, then seed capital disbursement
eligibility_reason: An African resident aged 18 or over qualifies on nationality, residence and age, but the programme requires a business idea or a business under 5 years old, which the profile does not record.
potential_issues: Requires a business idea or a business under 5 years old
Seed capital disbursed only after document review
relevance_reason: Relevant only if self-employment becomes part of the plan; otherwise it does not advance the job-search tracks.
action: Optional. If you have a business idea, prepare it for the 1 January 2027 opening.
notes: The official programme page still carries the 2025 title; the 1 January to 1 March window is stated as a yearly rule. 2 November 2026 (rerun): programme page re-read (window 1 January to 1 March on TEFConnect; seven phases: application, due diligence with World-Check screening and physical verification, shortlist, training, investment readiness, seed capital). Label lowered from Fully Funded to Partially Funded: the organiser describes training plus a USD 5,000 seed grant, never 'fully funded'.
